_note: Cutscene layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1; opacities 0 to 1. backdrop_color fills the letterbox, the dim behind the popup and the fade at the end; dim_opacity is how dark the picture goes behind the popup.
